transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant SailPoint ISC account/identity tools.

The `GET /v3/accounts` endpoint is exactly what you need. It supports a `filters` query parameter that lets you scope results to a single identity using `identityId eq "{id}"`, which returns every account correlated to that identity across all connected sources.

## List all accounts for an identity

```http
GET /v3/accounts?filters=identityId%20eq%20%22{identityId}%22
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

### Example — curl

```bash
IDENTITY_ID="2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"
TENANT="yourorg"
TOKEN="..."

curl -s \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/v3/accounts?filters=identityId%20eq%20%22${IDENTITY_ID}%22&count=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### Example — Python (requests)

```python
import requests

tenant = "yourorg"
identity_id = "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"
token = "..."

params = {
    "filters": f'identityId eq "{identity_id}"',
    "count": True,        # X-Total-Count header in response
    "limit": 250,         # max per page
    "offset": 0,
}

accounts = []
while True:
    resp = requests.get(
        f"https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/accounts",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        params=params,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    page = resp.json()
    accounts.extend(page)
    if len(page) < params["limit"]:
        break
    params["offset"] += params["limit"]

for acct in accounts:
    print(acct["id"], acct["name"], acct["sourceName"])
```

### Key points

| Detail | Value |
|---|---|
| Filter field | `identityId` |
| Operator | `eq` |
| Pagination | Use `limit` + `offset`; check `X-Total-Count` header (requires `count=true`) |
| `sourceName` field | Each returned account includes the source it belongs to, so one pass covers all sources |
| `detailLevel` | Defaults to `FULL`; use `SLIM` if you only need IDs/names |
